_README: Copy to optimiser_config.json to use. Any key left out keeps its default
Values marked ASSUMPTION in config.py are not in the source files -
confirm them with the transport office before acting on a plan.
These are the settings of the first real run (28 Oct 2026, after the GPS campaign):
buses leave school at 15:02 (dismissal 14:57 + 5 min loading) and stand 0.75 + 0.08 min
per rider, both as the GPS measured; R06 and R23 had no GPS runs to check, so they keep
Seats per bus: the school's vehicle list (29 Oct 2026). seat_fill 0.85 plans to 85% of them
(ASSUMPTION: R11 runs 'full' at 45 riders on 51 listed seats; confirm with a seat count).
arrival_buffer_min 5: every morning run is planned to reach school 5 min before reporting
time (GPS: buses arrive 0.4-16 min early, the same bus varies by up to 4.5 min day to day).
